ca5e986552d11f.s: The New Delhi Declaration of the International Big Cat Alliance is meant to be the first international declaration exclusively on:
ca5e986552d11f.x: The New Delhi Declaration is meant to be the first international declaration exclusively on big cats; the IBCA secretariat is in India, not Geneva.

ca50bad1335b02.x: Project Tiger was launched in 1973; 1972 is the year of the Wildlife Protection Act, which lists the tiger in Schedule I.

ca15034cb9a85c.s: The Zoological Survey of India (1916) is headquartered in:
ca15034cb9a85c.x: Both ZSI (1916) and BSI (1890) are headquartered in Kolkata; Chennai hosts the National Biodiversity Authority.

ca541cc9cd19c2.s: The Antarctic Treaty, signed in 1959, entered into force in:
ca541cc9cd19c2.x: The Antarctic Treaty was signed in 1959 and entered into force in 1961.

ca394d65678137.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Sukhna Wildlife Sanctuary and eco-sensitive zones?
o: Eco-sensitive zones are notified under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972.
Sukhna Wildlife Sanctuary lies in the Shivalik foothills.
Sukhna Wildlife Sanctuary was established in 1998.
Sukhna Wildlife Sanctuary is in Chandigarh.
ca394d65678137.x: Eco-sensitive zones are notified under the Environment Protection Act, 1986, not the Wildlife (Protection) Act; the Sukhna facts are correct.

cab474e00751e9.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Project Cheetah?
o: Phase I (September 2022) brought 8 cheetahs from Namibia.
Phase III (2026) brought 9 cheetahs from South Africa.
Phase II (February 2023) brought 12 cheetahs from South Africa.
The cheetah was declared extinct in India in 1952.
cab474e00751e9.x: Phase III in 2026 brought 9 cheetahs from Botswana, not South Africa; the other statements are correct.

ca82fc2eb80f54.s: The IUCN status of the Asiatic lion (Panthera leo persica) is:
ca82fc2eb80f54.x: The Asiatic lion is classified as Endangered, not Vulnerable; its only wild home, Gir National Park, was established in 1965.

ca5fbdd9693197.s: Trachischium lalremsangai, a new species reported in May 2026, is a/an:
ca5fbdd9693197.x: Trachischium lalremsangai is an insect-eating snake named after Prof. H. T. Lalremsanga; Labeo kaage is the fish 'Kaage Meenu'.

cac84068af4a82.s: The bent-toed gecko Cyrtodactylus raimonaensis was reported from near:
cac84068af4a82.x: Cyrtodactylus raimonaensis is from near Raimona NP in Kokrajhar, Assam; Limnonectes motijheel is from Namdapha Tiger Reserve.

cab34998cba4d0.s: Which is India's largest Ramsar site?
cab34998cba4d0.x: Sundarbans is India's largest Ramsar site; Vembannur Wetland Complex is now the smallest (earlier Renuka).

cae1402d4db5d3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Great Indian Bustard (Ardeotis nigriceps)?
o: It is Critically Endangered on the IUCN Red List.
It is listed in Schedule I of the Wildlife Protection Act.
It is listed in Schedule II of the Wildlife Protection Act.
It is listed in Appendix I of CITES.
cae1402d4db5d3.x: The Great Indian Bustard is in Schedule I of the Wildlife Protection Act and CITES Appendix I, not Schedule II.

ca3fba4eb1e348.s: According to India's first national report on bats (2024–25), how many bat species does India have?
ca3fba4eb1e348.x: India has 135 bat species, of which 16 are endemic and 7 are IUCN Threatened.

ca5d217af2b553.s: Gichak nakna, a subterranean fish reported in 2026, was found in:
ca5d217af2b553.x: Gichak nakna was found in western Assam; Chhapgarus ngankeeae is from Goa mangroves and Actinidia indica from near Ziro Valley.

ca14260010eb07.s: The National Innovations in Climate Resilient Agriculture (NICRA) programme covers how many districts?

cae2ff4c48ec5a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the River Basin Management Scheme?
o: It treats the whole river system as one hydrological unit.
It is implemented by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.
It has been extended to 2030–31 with an outlay of ₹2,183 crore.
cae2ff4c48ec5a.x: The River Basin Management Scheme is run by the Ministry of Jal Shakti, not MoEFCC; it is fully centrally funded and uses a hydrological-unit approach.

cacd04c330386f.s: According to India's Seventh National Report (NR7) to the CBD, how many of its 23 national biodiversity targets are on track?
cacd04c330386f.x: Only 2 of the 23 targets (NBT1 and NBT2) are on track.

caac28cf0f2a26.s: The Forest Survey of India's Anavaran portal sends forest-cover-loss alerts to States every:
caac28cf0f2a26.x: Anavaran, running since January 2024, uses satellite and machine-learning detection to alert States every 15 days.

ca724ad2e6f32d.s: The US Climate Prediction Center gave what chance of El Niño during May–July 2026?
ca724ad2e6f32d.x: The forecast chance of El Niño for May–July 2026 was 61%, not 51%.

ca41bd325b49bb.s: Apparent (feels-like) temperature combines air temperature with:
ca41bd325b49bb.x: Feels-like temperature combines temperature, humidity and wind, not pressure.

cac143d182bdc1.s: Navara Rice, a GI-tagged medicinal product, belongs to:
cac143d182bdc1.x: Navara Rice is a GI product of Kerala, not Karnataka.

ca81b19fd8282e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Oil India Limited?
o: It functions under the Ministry of Coal.
It is headquartered at Duliajan, Assam.
It functions under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
ca81b19fd8282e.x: Oil India Limited functions under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, not the Ministry of Coal.

ca711f97eef075.s: The Yana Caves, declared a national Geo-heritage site in 2026, lie in the:
ca711f97eef075.x: The about 2,700-million-year-old Yana Caves lie in the Western Ghats and were formed through tectonic and karst processes.

cad395931e40c1.s: Manas National Park was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in:
cad395931e40c1.x: Manas became a World Heritage Site in 1985 and a Biosphere Reserve in 1989.

ca917c57e5c088.s: The Aushadhi Vanaspati Mitra programme is associated with:
ca917c57e5c088.x: Aushadhi Vanaspati Mitra concerns medicinal plants, whose cultivation is now covered under MIDH.

ca37933d4ffb29.s: Improved cookstoves achieve fuller combustion mainly through:
ca37933d4ffb29.x: Secondary aeration gives fuller combustion; improved cookstoves reduce but do not eliminate indoor pollution.

ca8064c97f2180.s: The Mekong River Commission was established in:
ca8064c97f2180.x: The MRC was set up in 1995; its full members are Cambodia, Laos, Thailand and Vietnam.

ca738ba76e35f3.s: The jumping spider Mogrus shushka was reported from:
o: Desert areas of Rajasthan and Gujarat
ca738ba76e35f3.x: Mogrus shushka is from desert areas of Rajasthan and Gujarat; Mogrus pune is from Maharashtra's urban biodiversity parks.

caba4c0f67a4fb.s: Nagauri Ashwagandha received a GI tag in:
caba4c0f67a4fb.x: Nagauri Ashwagandha got its GI tag in 2025.

ca27c4c8696ef3.s: What was the theme of World Wetlands Day 2026?
o: Wetlands and traditional knowledge: Celebrating cultural heritage
Protecting Wetlands for Our Common Future
Wetlands Action for People and Nature
ca27c4c8696ef3.x: World Wetlands Day 2026, observed on 2 February, had the theme 'Wetlands and traditional knowledge: Celebrating cultural heritage'.

ca11326a6bfa69.s: How many Ramsar sites did India have in 2014?
ca11326a6bfa69.x: India had 26 Ramsar sites in 2014, rising to 98 in 2026 and covering 1,384,140 ha.

cab80edb91c5b9.s: Kumbhalgarh Wildlife Sanctuary, around which an Eco-Sensitive Zone has been notified, was established in:
cab80edb91c5b9.x: Kumbhalgarh WLS in Rajasthan's Aravallis was established in 1971, not 1986; its ESZ extends 0 to 1 km.

ca5e47239e06ae.s: Kaziranga National Park has the world's largest population of:
ca5e47239e06ae.x: Kaziranga has the world's largest population of one-horned rhinoceros; its river dolphin is the Gangetic river dolphin.

caa33389d16b6f.s: Palghar district, site of the proposed Vadhavan Port, was carved out of Thane in:
caa33389d16b6f.x: Palghar was carved out of Thane in 2014; Vadhavan is about 140 km north of Mumbai with a natural depth of about 20 m.

cac189d7744ed6.s: Goa became the second State after ____ to publish a state bird atlas.
cac189d7744ed6.x: Goa became the second State after Kerala to publish a state bird atlas.

ca9a7558a91f54.x: Elephant herds are matriarchal and gestation lasts 18–22 months.

ca0f7f9d5b32d1.s: Seven rare galaxy frogs in Kerala's Western Ghats were presumed dead because of:
ca0f7f9d5b32d1.x: The galaxy frogs vanished and were presumed dead because of disturbance by photo tourism.

ca983f01b674b6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: Mount Bur Ni Telong is part of the Atlantic Ring of Fire.
Mount Bur Ni Telong is in Aceh Province, Sumatra.
The Red Sea lies between Africa and Arabia.
Mount Bur Ni Telong is a 2,624 m stratovolcano.
ca983f01b674b6.x: Bur Ni Telong is part of the Pacific Ring of Fire, not an Atlantic one; the other statements are correct.

ca6160c68a1233.s: Kavindapadi nattu sakkarai, a GI-tagged product of Tamil Nadu, is from:
ca6160c68a1233.x: Kavindapadi nattu sakkarai is from Erode; Woraiyur sari is from Tiruchi and Ambasamudram Choppu Saman from Tirunelveli.

ca943098ca3908.s: Under the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026, the Polluter Pays principle involves:
o: Tracking the full lifecycle of waste
Oversight of landfills by District Collectors
ca943098ca3908.x: Polluter Pays involves environmental compensation; the portal tracks the lifecycle and District Collectors oversee landfills.

ca8dd1f7cd1752.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026?
o: They come into force on 1 April 2026.
Disposal is the last resort in their waste hierarchy.
Their waste hierarchy places prevention first.
They replace the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2022.
ca8dd1f7cd1752.x: The 2026 Rules replace the SWM Rules, 2016, not 2022.

ca048d0984971f.s: What is the IUCN status of the Chinese pangolin?
ca048d0984971f.x: The Chinese pangolin is Critically Endangered, while the Indian pangolin is Endangered; both are in Schedule I and CITES Appendix I.

cab34945bf3fb4.s: Which State became the first to declare a state microbe?
cab34945bf3fb4.x: Kerala declared Bacillus subtilis, a Gram-positive, spore-forming probiotic, its state microbe.

caf58389425942.s: Protection of the Aravallis has been treated as part of the jurisprudence of:
caf58389425942.x: Protection of the Aravallis is part of Article 21 jurisprudence, not Article 14.

cabba64a046fee.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Aravallis?
o: A restoration pilot covered four villages around Gurugram.
About 43% of households in the study depend on Aravalli forests for fodder, fuelwood and medicinal plants.
The range is nearly two billion years old.
Guru Shikhar, the highest peak of the range, is in Gujarat.
cabba64a046fee.x: Guru Shikhar (1,722 m) is at Mount Abu in Rajasthan, not Gujarat; the restoration-study facts are correct.

ca232d559cfd2f.s: Calamaria mizoramensis, recorded from Mizoram, is a:
ca232d559cfd2f.x: Calamaria mizoramensis is a non-venomous reed snake from Mizoram; Gegeneophis valmikii is a caecilian from Maharashtra.

ca56f7e2ddbeb1.s: Unlike the Kyoto Protocol, the Paris Agreement follows a ____ approach.
ca56f7e2ddbeb1.x: The Paris Agreement follows a bottom-up approach with national targets; the Kyoto Protocol was top-down.

cad47633499e74.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about bomb cyclones and hurricanes?
o: A bomb cyclone derives energy from temperature contrast.
A bomb cyclone is a mid-latitude storm.
A hurricane has a cold core.
A bomb cyclone has a cold core.
cad47633499e74.x: A hurricane is tropical and warm-core; a bomb cyclone is mid-latitude, cold-core and driven by temperature contrast.

cae0a87cbe78d2.s: On mass autopsies, the NDMA guidelines for Disaster Victim Identification:
o: Require them for all air crashes
cae0a87cbe78d2.x: India's first national DVI guidelines and SOPs discourage mass autopsies.

ca67763ed5ccc1.s: Nagauri Ashwagandha became Rajasthan's ____ agricultural GI after Sojat Mehndi.
ca67763ed5ccc1.x: Nagauri Ashwagandha became Rajasthan's second agricultural GI, after Sojat Mehndi.

cae7503c22304a.s: The Sea of Japan connects to the Pacific Ocean through the:
cae7503c22304a.x: The Sea of Japan reaches the Pacific through the Tsugaru Strait; Tsushima leads to the East China Sea and Kanmon to the Inland Sea.

cafd91d0d15ca6.s: Chlorophytum comosum is the scientific name of:
cafd91d0d15ca6.x: Spider Plant is Chlorophytum comosum; Areca Palm is Dypsis lutescens and Weeping Fig is Ficus benjamina.

cad3bc6d6116d6.s: Jawaharnagar, a landfill methane hotspot, is in:
cad3bc6d6116d6.x: Jawaharnagar is the Hyderabad hotspot; Delhi's are Ghazipur and Bhalswa, and Dhapa is in Kolkata.

ca2569e9b72849.s: Barren Island, India's only active volcano, lies about 135 km ____ of Port Blair.
ca2569e9b72849.x: Barren Island lies about 135 km north-east of Port Blair, not south-east.

ca948c6e04db94.s: The Rengali Dam, cited among causes of the elephant emergency in central India, was built in:
ca948c6e04db94.x: The Rengali Dam dates from 1985, not 1995; droughts, mining and linear infrastructure were the other causes.

cacfc6ec901aef.s: The dugong, called the 'sea cow', depends for food on:
cacfc6ec901aef.x: Dugong dugon is a seagrass-dependent herbivore found in India in the Gulf of Mannar and Palk Bay.

ca808d06401e0a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Mount Bur Ni Telong volcano alert?
o: The volcano is in Bener Meriah Regency, Aceh Province.
Indonesia reduced the alert level after a surge in seismic activity.
ca808d06401e0a.x: Indonesia raised, not reduced, the alert level and began evacuations.

ca1d18a66b9483.s: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is confirmed by:
ca1d18a66b9483.x: COPD, a progressive and irreversible disease led by tobacco smoking, is confirmed by spirometry.

caee5290b530a4.s: In monsoon disaster resilience, slope stabilisation was cited as the model of:
caee5290b530a4.x: Slope stabilisation was associated with Japan; the Netherlands was cited for floodplain zoning.

ca43eb03c8db10.s: The Northeast monsoon is also called the:
ca43eb03c8db10.x: The Northeast monsoon is the retreating monsoon; about three cyclonic disturbances form per season in the Bay of Bengal.

caacfe525fed96.s: Rain-fed areas account for about what share of India's net sown area?
caacfe525fed96.x: Rain-fed areas make up 60% of the net sown area, not 50%.

ca8ef662e4544c.s: Parasopubia gorensis, a new plant species from the Western Ghats, was found at:
ca8ef662e4544c.x: Parasopubia gorensis was found at Goregudda; Oberonia marnkuliensis is from Marnkuli Hill and Utricularia kumtensis from near Mirjan Fort.

ca6aea2373ee69.s: The Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan (September 2025) aims to promote tribal grassroots leadership in:
ca6aea2373ee69.x: The Adi Karmayogi Abhiyan targets tribal grassroots leadership in 1 lakh villages.

cae38ea0e389e0.s: In monitoring stubble burning, burn scars are detected by:
cae38ea0e389e0.x: Sentinel-2 detects burn scars, while the thermal satellites MODIS and VIIRS can miss evening fires.

cacb7b1b7707e0.s: The COP that called for a 'transition away' from fossil fuels in 2023 was held in:
cacb7b1b7707e0.x: COP28 in Dubai (2023) called for a 'transition away' from fossil fuels.

ca9c401e5753ce.s: The Central Water Commission found how many of India's 681 glacial lakes to be expanding?
ca9c401e5753ce.x: The CWC recorded expansion in 432 of 681 glacial lakes.

ca3385d7ce54cb.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's surface solar-radiation outlook?
o: Surface solar radiation may fall by up to 10% over central, southern and eastern India.
North-west India is projected to be the most unstable region.
The Indo-Gangetic Plains and the North-East may see a marginal increase under low emissions.
The study was by researchers of Savitribai Phule Pune University.
ca3385d7ce54cb.x: The statement on north-west India reverses the finding; the Indo-Gangetic Plains and North-East may see a marginal rise under low emissions.

caa24ed7f04d45.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's 2030 Nationally Determined Contribution?
o: Emissions intensity of GDP is to be cut by 45% from 2005 levels.
The additional carbon-sink target is 2.5–3 billion tonnes of CO2e.
The long-term goal is net zero by 2070.
caa24ed7f04d45.x: The 2030 non-fossil installed-capacity target is 50%, not 45%.

ca9c5836ee2de2.s: The 2025 southwest monsoon was about how much above normal?
ca9c5836ee2de2.x: The 2025 monsoon was 8% above the 87 cm long-period average; 27% was the excess of North-west India.

ca0b4b1475e4e2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 2025 monsoon and disaster resilience?
o: Compensatory afforestation restores the same biodiversity as the original ecosystem.
Monsoon 2025 rain came largely in concentrated bursts.
IMD defines a cloudburst as at least 100 mm of rain in one hour.
The August 2025 floods hit Punjab and Delhi.
ca0b4b1475e4e2.x: Compensatory afforestation does not restore the original ecosystem's biodiversity; the other statements are correct.

cabdab79ff62cf.s: As of 31 May 2025, which State had the highest number of pending Forest Rights Act claims?
cabdab79ff62cf.x: Telangana had the most pending claims (3.29 lakh); Odisha had 1.20 lakh.

cad3214f16e815.s: The Kenton R. Miller Award, instituted in 2006, is presented:
cad3214f16e815.x: The award is biennial and is named after former IUCN Director General Kenton R. Miller.

ca603e6d30aab1.s: The Geological Survey of India is headquartered at:
ca603e6d30aab1.x: GSI, founded in 1851, is headquartered in Kolkata and functions under the Ministry of Mines.

ca764840173d22.s: The IUCN status of the Asian giant tortoise (Manouria emys phayrei) is:
ca764840173d22.x: The Asian giant tortoise, the largest tortoise of mainland Asia, is Critically Endangered; its Indian range does not include A&N.

caf0a4ba131358.s: How many hatchlings did the August 2025 Asian giant tortoise effort in Manipur produce?
caf0a4ba131358.x: The effort produced 28 hatchlings; 25 staff were trained on 21 August 2025.

ca160df43bcdf5.s: The ONGC well blowout in Sivasagar, Assam, which began on 12 June 2025, was controlled by:
ca160df43bcdf5.x: The blowout was controlled by 21 June 2025.

ca59a123d66cea.s: The sea slug Phidiana unilineata was first recorded from Visakhapatnam in:
ca59a123d66cea.x: It was first recorded in 1864 by Alder and Hancock, not 1865.

ca3f1290f0192b.s: Which body monitored the matter of the dry-waste fire in Minicoy?
ca3f1290f0192b.x: The National Green Tribunal monitored the matter, though tourism was not halted.

ca53e93bc059e1.s: Which city was cited for its Heat Action Plan as a climate-resilience model?
ca53e93bc059e1.x: Ahmedabad's Heat Action Plan was cited; Kolkata was cited for flood forecasting and Chennai for stormwater management.

nb473f684bf2.s: The Guchimi Kumki camp in Andhra Pradesh is in which district?
nb473f684bf2.x: Guchimi camp is in Parvathipuram-Manyam; Chittoor has the Musallamadugu camp.

ca65a8be128e50.s: Despite being in a highly seismic zone, Himalayan towns largely follow:
o: Seismic codes made for hill towns
ca65a8be128e50.x: Himalayan towns follow generic plains building codes despite high seismicity, and building over springs is a problem.

new.s: According to the World Air Quality Report 2025 (IQAir), the world's most polluted city was:
new.x: Loni in Ghaziabad, UP, was the world's most polluted city (112.5 µg/m³); New Delhi was the most polluted capital.

new.s: In the World Air Quality Report 2025, India was ranked the world's ____ most polluted country.
new.x: India was 6th by PM2.5; Pakistan was 1st.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the World Air Quality Report 2025:
1. It was released by IQAir.
2. Pakistan was the most polluted country.
3. New Delhi was the most polluted capital.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All three are correct: the IQAir report (24 March 2026) ranked Pakistan first and named New Delhi the most polluted capital.

new.s: India's updated NDC targets what cut in the emissions intensity of GDP from 2005 levels by 2035?
new.x: The new NDC targets 47% by 2035; 45% is the 2022 NDC target for 2030.

new.s: India's updated NDC sets an additional carbon sink target of ____ by 2035.
new.x: The new NDC raises the carbon sink target to 3.5–4 billion t CO₂e; 2.5–3 billion t was the 2022 target.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Paris Agreement?
o: It explicitly mentions phasing out fossil fuels.
It was adopted at COP21 in 2015.
Its Global Stocktake has no binding targets or fines.
new.x: The Paris Agreement does not explicitly mention fossil fuels; the other statements are correct.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT among the seven big cats covered by the International Big Cat Alliance?
new.x: IBCA covers tiger, lion, leopard, snow leopard, cheetah, jaguar and puma; the clouded leopard is not among them.

new.s: With Saudi Arabia joining on 22 May 2026, the membership of the International Big Cat Alliance rose to:
new.x: Saudi Arabia's entry took IBCA to 26 members and 5 observers; Bangladesh later became the 27th.

new.s: The National Innovations in Climate Resilient Agriculture (NICRA) programme is run by:
new.x: NICRA is run by ICAR, not MoEFCC, and covers 651 districts.

new.s: In Germanwatch's Climate Risk Index 2025, India ranked ____ for the year 2024 alone.
new.x: India was 15th for 2024 alone and 9th worst hit for 1995–2024.

new.s: Which of the following is a primary pollutant?
new.x: Carbon monoxide is emitted directly; ozone and PAN are secondary pollutants formed in the air.

new.s: Western Disturbances bring winter rain and snow mainly to:
new.x: Western Disturbances bring winter rain and snow to north-west India, not the south.

new.s: What is the outlay of the National Beekeeping and Honey Mission (2020–21 to 2025–26)?
new.x: NBHM, the 'Sweet Revolution' scheme, has an outlay of ₹500 crore.

new.s: In the Climate Change Performance Index 2026, India was ranked:
new.x: India fell 13 places from 10th to 23rd; 9th is its Climate Risk Index rank.

new.s: The State Energy Efficiency Index 2024 was released by:
o: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
new.x: SEEI 2024 was released by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (Ministry of Power) with AEEE.

new.s: In the State Energy Efficiency Index 2024, which State topped the group consuming 5–15 MToE?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh topped the 5–15 MToE group; Maharashtra, Assam and Tripura topped the other groups.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Climate Change Performance Index 2026:
1. It is published by Germanwatch, NewClimate Institute and Climate Action Network.
2. Its top three ranks were left empty.
3. India moved up from 'medium' to 'high' performer.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; India slipped from 'high' to 'medium' performer.

new.s: CITES CoP20 (24 November – 5 December 2025) was held in:
new.x: CITES CoP20 was held in Samarkand, Uzbekistan.

new.s: How many species were added to the CITES Appendices at CoP20?
new.x: CoP20 added 77 species, including sharks and iguanas, and kept the rhino horn and ivory trade bans.

new.s: The New Collective Quantified Goal (NCQG) agreed at COP29 provides for at least ____ a year by 2035.
new.x: The NCQG provides at least USD 300 billion a year by 2035; USD 100 billion was the earlier commitment.

new.s: Which index ranked India 9th most affected by extreme weather for 1995–2024?
new.x: The Germanwatch Climate Risk Index ranks impact; the CCPI ranks performance (India 23rd).

new.s: Which river is India's largest gharial habitat?
new.x: The Chambal is the largest gharial habitat (2,400+); the Gandak is the second-largest.

new.s: The Lohit, whose valley saw forest fires fought by IAF aerial water bombing, is a tributary of the:
new.x: The Lohit is a Brahmaputra tributary, not a Ganga tributary.

new.s: Under the Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026, the black bin is meant for:
new.x: Black is for special-care waste; green is wet, blue is dry and red is sanitary.

new.s: According to NTCA, how many tiger deaths were recorded in India in 2025?
new.x: NTCA recorded 166 tiger deaths in 2025 against 126 in 2024; Madhya Pradesh had 55.

new.s: A bomb cyclone involves a fall in central pressure of at least ____ in 24 hours.
new.x: Bombogenesis means a pressure drop of at least 24 millibars in 24 hours.

new.s: The Climate Change Performance Index 2026, in which India ranked 23rd, was released at:
new.x: CCPI 2026 was released at COP30 in Belém in November 2025.

new.s: The Bureau of Energy Efficiency, which released the State Energy Efficiency Index 2024, functions under the:
o: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
new.x: SEEI 2024 was released in August 2025 by BEE, Ministry of Power.

new.s: Ramsar COP15 (23–31 July 2025) was held at:
new.x: Ramsar COP15 met at Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe, and adopted the Victoria Falls Declaration.

new.s: India's resolution adopted at Ramsar COP15 was on:
new.x: India's resolution on sustainable lifestyles was adopted at Ramsar COP15.

new.s: Menar and Khichan, added as Ramsar sites on World Environment Day 2025, are in:
new.x: Menar (Udaipur) and Khichan (Phalodi) are in Rajasthan.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about CITES CoP20:
1. It was held in Samarkand, Uzbekistan.
2. It added 77 species to the CITES Appendices.
3. It lifted the ban on rhino horn trade.
